title: Idea for directed-energy UFO shootdowns came from a Roswell survivor

tellings.quote: Harold told Pippa on his deathbed and offair that the CIA and Atomic Energy Commission got the very idea of shooting down UFOs with directed energy from an extraterrestrial being that survived the Roswell crash in 1947.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says that Harald Malmgren, a former presidential adviser, told Pippa Malmgren privately, on his deathbed, a remarkable story about the reported 1947 crash of a strange object near Roswell, New Mexico. According to that account, the CIA, the US spy agency, and the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency over nuclear work, got the very idea of shooting down UFOs with directed energy, meaning beams such as lasers or microwaves, from an alien who survived that crash. If true, a non-human being would have taught the US how to bring down its own kind's craft.
